recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast facial portrait emerging from deep shadow, framed by a multi-line white border and topped with elegant, widely spaced script and serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a void-like black background
High-gloss red lips as the primary focal point
Delicate white typography contrasting against dark hair
Rigid geometric border framing organic facial curves
coreInvariants: Soft-focus skin texture with sharp eye and lip highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered facial portrait, filling approximately 80% of the inner frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glossy red lips positioned in the lower-center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright typography at the top, down the bridge of the nose to the lips, then circling back to the eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounding the face, particularly at the top and sides.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white border/text and the black background; high saturation on the lips against muted skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of elegant copperplate-style script and high-contrast transitional serif.
letterConstructionRules: Uppercase initials in a flowing, calligraphic script with thin hairlines
Lowercase letters in a clean, spaced-out serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 's' and 'e' have open, airy counters

anatomy.terminals: Ball terminals on script, sharp serifs on body

composition.scale: Large enough to span the width of the face

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Script for initials to provide elegance, Serif for body to provide legibility and structure.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate initials and the high-contrast serif body.
Matches the delicate, looping nature of the script elements.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a woman with warm skin and dark hair, emerging from a black background. Focus on glossy red lips and smoky eye makeup. Frame the entire image with a thin white triple-line border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text at the top using a white font. Use an ornate script for the first letter of each word and a high-contrast serif for the rest. Apply very wide tracking so the text spans the width of the inner frame.

verificationChecks: Are the lips a vibrant, glossy red?
Is the typography white and widely spaced?
Does the triple-line border frame the entire composition?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist

mustAchieve: Deep, true blacks in the background
Crisp, clean white lines for the border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the border lines are parallel and sharp.
Verify the red of the lips is the most saturated element.
Confirm the eyes have a catchlight for a 'living' look.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject (centered) + Chiaroscuro lighting + Glossy accent color + Wide-tracked hybrid script/serif typography + Multi-line geometric border.
